Definition: used very widely as demonstrative, lo!; interrogative, whether?; or conditional, if, although; also Oh that!, when; hence, as a negative, not
BiblicalUsage: 1) if; 1a) conditional clauses; 1a1) of possible situations; 1a2) of impossible situations; 1b) oath contexts; 1b1) no, not; 1c) if...if, whether...or, whether...or...or; 1d) when, whenever; 1e) since; 1f) interrogative particle; 1g) but rather
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
